description: Standard SaaS Master Services Agreement with reciprocal liability cap and mutual indemnity

clauses.text: Neither party's total aggregate liability under this Agreement shall exceed the total amounts paid or payable by Customer in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to liability.
Each party shall defend and indemnify the other party against third-party claims arising out of gross negligence or willful misconduct.
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.

description: Enterprise SOW with non-standard jurisdiction and missing limitation of liability cap

clauses.text: Vendor agrees to assume unlimited liability for any direct, indirect, consequential, or incidental damages resulting from software delivery delays.
This contract shall be governed by the laws of the Cayman Islands without regard to conflict of law principles.

description: High-risk vendor agreement containing pre-existing IP expropriation and unilateral indemnification

clauses.text: Customer hereby transfers and assigns all rights, title, interest, and pre-existing background IP owned prior to this Agreement unconditionally to Vendor.
Customer agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Vendor against any and all claims, without limitation, arising from any system downtime.

description: Unilateral immediate termination and non-compliant GDPR cross-border data transfer clause

clauses.text: Vendor reserves the right to terminate this agreement immediately within 24 hours without prior notice or opportunity to cure.
Personal data collected in the EU may be freely transferred and stored in non-adequate jurisdictions without Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) or legal safeguards.
